svg.text: Status and scopes shown here are what the admin's kill switch and any support/security review acts on.View Agent Connections ⓘ

Authorized against the calling connection's stored scopes from AgentConnectionSummary before the read reaches this read model. ConversationContext itself is projected by Front's existing conversation system, out of scope for this model.Agent Reads Conversation ⓘ
Requires the draft_reply scope on the calling connection, checked against AgentConnectionSummary.Agent Drafts Reply ⓘ
The agent never sends to the customer directly. Every send is this command, issued by a human rep, whether the text is untouched or fully rewritten.Rep Sends Reply ⓘ
Every scoped agent action gets one audit entry, not just drafts; this slice shows the pattern for one action type.Log Agent Action ⓘ
